review_scope: Independent numeric, mathematical, source-attribution, and visual review of the final grouped-forecast report and figures.

findings.finding: Grouped-history contrasts are C-A and D-B. The report and figures now distinguish D-B from D-A, which is explicitly labeled as the joint DM065-plus-grouped candidate versus current B1 comparison.

Independent recount agrees with the report: C passes 8/11 protection and 2/15 recovery cells (10/26); D passes 9/11 and 2/15 (11/26); neither has a new recovery against A. The reported +2 h, 0.1 mm CSI changes are C-A +0.002826, D-A +0.001566, and D-B +0.003718.

The weak-rain and dry-transition counts reconcile with the frozen paired arrays. At +2 h, C gains three weak-observation hits, loses none, and has six dry false alarms both added and resolved; D-B gains six and loses four weak hits, with five dry false alarms added and fourteen resolved.

The pressure/Exner/temperature equations are mathematically consistent. The added relation δT/T ≃ δθ/θ + κδp/p is correctly scoped as a first-order continuous approximation and explicitly separated from the REAL32 replay. The report avoids attributing rainfall changes to a single physical process.

Visual review confirms the schematic shows the actual old left-associated expression and the grouped expression; CSI legends distinguish C-A, D-B, and joint D-A; maps show six absolute and six labeled comparison panels on shared binned-rain and symmetric-log difference scales. The final map colorbar uses ASCII minus signs, and no spatial interpolation is claimed.

The native operation receipt supports attribution at the captured target cell, lane, and calls only. Forecast evaluation covers one event and does not establish held-out generalization or isolated microphysical causality; these limits are stated in the report.

reviewer_conclusion: No unresolved substantive numeric, mathematical, source-attribution, or figure issue found. B1 retention is consistent with the frozen all-cell gate rule and independently recounted scores.
